target_task: directly supervised parts-and-whole teaching for the input-binding task

stage_to_target_mapping.name_function: per-candidate color match (3 binary) + final slot
stage_to_target_mapping.context: per-candidate shape match (3 binary) + final slot
stage_to_target_mapping.analogy: per-candidate both match (3 binary) + final slot
stage_to_target_mapping.mapping: per-candidate color match AND shape match (6 binary) + final slot
stage_to_target_mapping.decomposition: full parts table: color + shape + both match (9 binary) + final slot
stage_to_target_mapping.recomposition: per-candidate both match (3 binary) AND final slot
stage_to_target_mapping.reinforcement: full parts table (9 binary) + final slot, across changed-detail views

practice_frequency_per_aligned_cycle.timing: one parts-practice item after each of the seven stages; one complete-decision item after reinforcement
